+    # ---- ALN-10 回归用例默认消费（门禁证据链）------------------------
+    def _regression_dataset_for(self, cand: EvolutionCandidate
+                                ) -> Optional[EvalDataset]:
+        """按候选影响域筛 failures_regression 回归子集。
+
+        影响域：target_domain 显式给出，否则 target_component
+        `expert/<domain>` 指认。子集为空 → 不跑（回归是证据的结果，
+        不是评测的副作用）。
+        """
+        reg = self.datasets.get(_contracts.REGRESSION_DATASET_ID)
+        if reg is None or not reg.cases:
+            return None
+        domain = (getattr(cand, "target_domain", "") or "").strip()
+        if not domain:
+            comp = (getattr(cand, "target_component", "") or "").strip()
+            if comp.startswith("expert/"):
+                domain = comp.split("/", 1)[1]
+        if not domain:
+            return None
+        cases = [c for c in reg.cases
+                 if (getattr(c, "domain", "") or "") == domain]
+        if not cases:
+            return None
+        return EvalDataset(
+            dataset_id=f"{_contracts.REGRESSION_DATASET_ID}_{domain}",
+            version=reg.version,
+            task_category=reg.task_category,
+            source=_contracts.REGRESSION_DATASET_ID,
+            privacy=reg.privacy,
+            holdout=False,
+            cases=cases)
+
+    def _regression_supplement(self, cand: EvolutionCandidate
+                               ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        """回归子集补跑对比：基线 vs 候选在真实失败案例上的表现。
+
+        门禁独立裁决（ALN-10 扩散回归范围）：候选在已知失败案例上
+        相对基线退化 → 追加门禁失败理由。运行受候选实验预算约束
+        （调用方处于预算作用域内，评测器共用同一 runner）。
+        """
+        block: Dict[str, Any] = {}
+        reg_dataset = self._regression_dataset_for(cand)
+        if reg_dataset is None:
+            return block
+        reg_baseline = self.evaluator.run(
+            reg_dataset, baseline=True,
+            metadata={"kind": "regression_baseline",
+                      "candidate": cand.candidate_id})
+        reg_candidate = self.evaluator.run(
+            reg_dataset, baseline=False,
+            metadata={"candidate": cand.candidate_id,
+                      "kind": "regression"})
+        degraded = (reg_candidate.success_rate
+                    < reg_baseline.success_rate)
+        block = {
+            "dataset": reg_dataset.dataset_id,
+            "case_count": len(reg_dataset.cases),
+            "baseline_success_rate": round(reg_baseline.success_rate, 3),
+            "candidate_success_rate": round(reg_candidate.success_rate, 3),
+            "degraded": degraded,
+        }
+        if degraded:
+            block["reason"] = (
+                f"回归子集退化: {reg_dataset.dataset_id} "
+                f"基线{block['baseline_success_rate']}"
+                f"→候选{block['candidate_success_rate']} "
+                f"(候选不得在已知失败案例上低于基线)")
+        return block
+
     def _persist(self, cand: EvolutionCandidate) -> None:

         if self.store is not None:
